title: Senior Project lead
description:
Location: Noida, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Engineering Delivery Manager – Identity Platform (AI\-Driven SDLC)**
======================================================================

**Overview**
------------


We are looking for an **Engineering Delivery Manager** to **lead delivery across multiple squads** building and evolving a **cloud\-native Identity Platform**. You will drive **predictable outcomes**, **high engineering quality**, and adoption of our **AI\-driven SDLC**—improving **speed**, **reliability**, and **compliance** through modern ways of working.


You will lead a delivery organisation of **\~20 engineers**, shaping squads around **product priorities**, coaching **delivery discipline**, and ensuring teams use **AI tooling** (coding, test generation, documentation, triage) to raise **throughput** and **quality**.


Partner with **Product**, **Architecture**, **Security** and **Platform** stakeholders to translate roadmap intent into **executable plans**, manage **dependencies** and **risks**, and deliver **measurable outcomes**.


This is a **hands\-on leadership role** focused on **delivery excellence** and **AI\-enabled transformation**.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own end\-to\-end delivery** across multiple squads (scope, plan, dependencies, risks, and outcomes).
* **Lead, coach and develop** \~20 engineers; set clear expectations and give timely feedback.
* **Establish delivery discipline**: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
* **Champion an AI\-first engineering culture**; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.
* **Ensure engineering excellence**: quality, security, reliability, and operability by design.

### **AI\-Driven SDLC \& Transformation**

* **Embed our AI\-driven SDLC** (AI\-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day\-to\-day delivery.
* **Drive adoption of AI ways of working** (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.
* **Measure impact and improve** (cycle time, defect escape rate, automation coverage, and developer experience) and act on insights.
* **Ensure responsible use of AI** aligned to **security**, **privacy**, and **compliance** expectations.

### **Delivery Execution**

* **Shape and adjust squads** based on roadmap priorities, skills, and capacity.
* **Run planning and execution rituals**; manage dependencies and cross\-team alignment.
* **Remove impediments**, manage delivery risk early, and **drive predictable releases**.
* **Use metrics to improve flow** efficiency, quality, and operational readiness.

### **Stakeholder Partnership**

* **Partner with Product** to clarify scope, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* **Provide clear delivery commitments**, trade\-offs, and status—**no surprises**.
* **Align with Architecture/Security/Operations** to ensure designs are scalable and compliant.

### **People, Talent \& Operations**

* **Hire and retain diverse talent**; build capability plans with explicit **AI upskilling**.
* **Set performance expectations**, coach growth, and build a feedback culture aligned to **Thales leadership**.
* **Own capacity and execution tracking**; escalate risks with options.
* **Ensure operational excellence** (on\-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **7\+ years** in software engineering with **3\+ years** leading delivery and/or people in multi\-team environments.
* **Track record delivering** cloud\-native, distributed and **security\-sensitive** platforms (identity experience a plus).
* **Strong delivery management**: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.
* **Modern SDLC practices** (CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps).
* **Proven change leadership**: scaling new tools and practices, including **AI\-assisted development**.
* **AI fluency**: hands\-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach **safe, effective adoption**.

**Success Looks Like**
----------------------

* **Predictable delivery**: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on\-time releases with transparent trade\-offs.
* **AI\-driven SDLC adopted** across squads with measurable improvements in **cycle time**, **automation coverage**, and **quality**.
* **Strong engineering outcomes**: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.
* **High\-performing teams**: clear expectations, visible growth, and healthy engagement/retention.

**Reporting Line**
------------------


This role reports to the Engineering Director.


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**

**Location\- Pune/Bangalore**

 **What you will do:**

  

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.

  



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

 **How you will do it:**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.
 **What we look for:**

**Required**

* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.
  

Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\+ years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you’ll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility.


Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI\-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams.


Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives.
* Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes.

Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback * \- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth.

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects — it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs.

* Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization.
* Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication.
* Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete.
* Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs

Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI\-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves — not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote.


You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team \- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation.

 8\+ years in software engineering, with significant hands\-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production.

 Hands\-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi\-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools.

 Fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow.

 Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud\-native observability.

 Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship.

Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
 We are looking for a
 **Lead AI Engineer** 
 in
 **Bangalore** 
 to help build Messaging 3\.0, our next\-generation intelligent patient communication platform. You will design and build production\-grade AI agents end to end — from LLM orchestration, tool integration, and evaluation to guardrails, observability, reliability, and production operations. You will also be the technical lead for this initiative, setting the technical direction and mentoring engineers through influence rather than formal authority.
   

  

 In your first 90 days, you will help establish the foundation for the AI\-driven Intelligent Messaging platform, including core services, supporting services, Temporal workflows, and two initial agents: the Notification AI Agent and Cadence Outreach AI Agent.
   

  

 Over your first year, you will take these agents to production and build next\-best\-action intelligence so they can act autonomously and reliably toward the intended outcome of each message. You will also ensure the new architecture continues to support the important use cases handled by our existing legacy monolith and microservices.
   

  

**About the Team:** 
 The Messaging team is building Messaging 3\.0 — moving from static notifications and campaign\-based outreach to intelligent, agent\-orchestrated patient communication.
   

  

 Our AI agents will use patient context, preferences, workflow state, and tools to:
   

  

* Determine the next best action.
* Personalize patient communication.
* Select the right communication channel.
* Manage the interaction through to completion.


 This is a mix of greenfield and brownfield development. You will build new services while also replacing or wrapping existing systems that support live patient messaging in production today.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical design and development of the Messaging 3\.0 AI platform.
* Build production\-grade AI agents using LLM orchestration, tools, context, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
* Design and build scalable services using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kubernetes, and AWS.
* Design and implement Temporal workflows for long\-running and failure\-prone processes, including retries and compensation.
* Build and take the Notification AI Agent and Cadence Outreach AI Agent to production.
* Build next\-best\-action intelligence that enables agents to act autonomously and predictably toward the intended message outcome.
* Identify and solve AI agent reliability and unpredictability issues in production.
* Ensure the new architecture continues to cover use cases supported by the existing legacy monolith and microservices.
* Drive high\-quality delivery and continuously improve engineering speed, quality, and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers through influence rather than formal authority.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Work across both greenfield and brownfield systems.
* Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to establish technical direction and alignment.
* Own technical outcomes end to end, from design through production.
* Adapt as requirements and the architecture evolve.
* Evaluate and adopt new AI and agent technologies as the space changes.
* Build systems that are reliable and predictable in production, not just successful in demos.
* Understand existing messaging systems well enough to avoid gaps in functionality during modernization.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building AI agents.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot in production.
* Strong system design and software architecture experience, including architectural trade\-offs and decision\-making.
* Production experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Temporal or an equivalent durable workflow orchestration framework.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent agent framework.
* Experience taking an AI/agentic system from prototype to reliable production.
* Strong understanding of AI/agent engineering, including reliability, evaluation, guardrails, and observability.
* Production experience with AWS and practical experience making AWS architecture decisions.
* Experience with Kafka, Postgres, Redis, Helm, Datadog, or equivalent observability tools is a plus.
* Data science experience is a plus.
* GenAI experience beyond agent frameworks, such as prompt/model evaluation or fine\-tuning, is a plus.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous and evolving environments and leading through influence.

title: Member Technical Staff - Applied AI Engineer (US Timing)
description:
**Member of Technical Staff – Applied AI Engineering**

**EXPERIENCE: 2–4 years**  

**TYPE: Full\-time**  

**FOCUS: Applied AI Customer\-facing**  

**WORK HOURS: US Timings**  

**LOCATION: Bengaluru**

 **ABOUT THE COMPANY**


At Composio, we are building infrastructure that allows AI agents to communicate with the tools people use for work, including GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Salesforce, and more. We are a small team of engineers working across context, auth, execution, and reliability to build the action layer for AI agents.  

  

We raised a $25M Series A from Lightspeed, with angel investors including Guillermo Rauch (CEO of Vercel), Dharmesh Shah (CTO of HubSpot), and Gokul Rajaram. Our customers range from YC startups to companies like Brex, Glean, Zoom, and more.

 **ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

This is an applied AI engineering role, not a traditional support role. You will work directly with customers, learn the repeated work behind their problems, and build agentic systems that take that work over. When a customer needs direct engineering, you will debug and ship. When a pattern repeats, you will turn it into a workflow, eval, tool, or product capability that compounds.

* **The frontier:** support is one of the richest applied AI environments — an agent has to gather context, reason across systems, use tools, take bounded action, verify the outcome, and communicate clearly. You design that system.
* **The trust bar:** AI cannot be trusted by default with customer support. You define state, permissions, guardrails, evals, and escalation paths so the automation earns trust.
* **The feedback loop:** it's immediate. Deploy into real support work, watch where the system fails, and improve it until people can hand over more of the job.

  

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **What you'll build**

* Agentic workflows that take over support functions: intake, classification, context gathering, reproduction, diagnosis, response drafting, remediation, verification, and follow\-up.
* Tool\-using agents that safely inspect runs, logs, auth state, configuration, and provider behavior, then propose or execute bounded recovery actions.
* Eval suites for diagnostic correctness, resolution quality, safe escalation, customer communication, and end\-to\-end task completion.
* Human\-in\-the\-loop systems that make ownership, uncertainty, approvals, handoffs, and failure states explicit.
* The observability, memory, and feedback loops that let these agents improve from real support cases without repeating mistakes.
* Product improvements that remove entire classes of customer issues instead of handling the same symptoms faster.

 **How you'll work**

* Start with the customer outcome, then work backward into the model, workflow, tooling, or product change required to deliver it.
* Own the hardest issues end to end when direct engineering is needed: reproduce, isolate, mitigate, ship, communicate, and verify the resolution with the customer.
* Sit with customers and partner with Support, FDE, Product, and Engineering to find work that should become software.
* Move from a rough prototype to a reliable production workflow, with traces, evals, guardrails, and a clear human fallback.
* Use frontier models, coding agents, and internal AI tools every day to multiply your own engineering output.
* Measure success in customer outcomes improved, support work removed, and classes of failure prevented.

 **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* **Experience level:** 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience.

  

**Applied AI engineering*** You have built production systems with language models, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, multi\-step workflows, or agent memory.
* You know how to use models and coding agents as leverage, and where their non\-determinism creates hidden risk.
* You use evals, traces, failure analysis, and fast iteration to make AI systems dependable.

  

**Strong systems engineering*** You are an experienced backend, platform, or integration engineer who has shipped and operated production software.
* You can debug across SDKs, HTTP, OAuth, webhooks, queues, data stores, logs, and third\-party APIs.
* You turn an ambiguous failure into a minimal reproduction, a root cause, and a durable fix.

  

**Customer\-adjacent building**  

* You are deliberately choosing to work closer to customers because you want a tighter loop between what you build and the impact it creates.
* You enjoy talking directly with technical users, turning a vague problem into a system, and watching that system change their outcome.
* You communicate clearly under uncertainty, ask the exact next question, and never bluff.

 **Workflow and product judgment**  

* You can model a support function as states, tools, permissions, handoffs, verification steps, and escalation rules.
* You know what should be automated, what should remain human, and how to increase autonomy without reducing trust.
* You fix the class of problem, not only the visible symptom.

  

**OPTIONAL*** TypeScript or Python in production.
* Experience building AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or eval infrastructure.
* Experience with a developer platform, API product, support engineering, SRE, or incident response.
* Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, rate limits, Postgres, queues, and cloud observability.
* Experience with support systems such as Plain, Zendesk, Intercom, or Salesforce.
* Public technical writing, open source contributions, or unusually good debugging notes.

At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

Competitive benchmarks do not intimidate you. You have run them, you know where VCS wins, and you can explain it in terms that matter to the person signing the contract. You care about the craft.
